#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>

void reverse_i32(int32_t *arr, size_t n) {
    if (!arr || n < 2) return;
    size_t i = 0, j = n - 1;
    while (i < j) {
        int32_t tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
        ++i;
        --j;
    }
}

local Particle = {}
Particle.__index = Particle

function Particle.new(x, y)
    return setmetatable({ x = x or 0, y = y or 0 }, Particle)
end
